newsitem.title: UK: Shell in Caspian pipeline deal with Rosneft.
newsitem.headline: Shell in Caspian pipeline deal with Rosneft.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch oil major Royal Dutch/Shell confirmed on Thursday that it will support Russia's Rosneft oil company in its participation in a $1.5 billion oil pipeline project from Kazakhstan to the Black Sea.
In a statement released in London, the group said Shell Caspian BV had agreed to form a joint venture to finance a planned 7.5 percent stake in Caspian Pipeline Consortium (CPC).
Details of the joint deal had been announced in June by Roesneft but remained unconfirmed by Shell until now.
Shell will have a 49 percent stake in the venture company, Rosneft-Shell Casian Ventures Ltd, and Rosneft 51 percent.
Shell said the plan to invest in CPC was "to secure effective evacuation of crude oil production for their exploration and development activities".
